answer: The wander detector writes each match to the quartz queue, and the oasis checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A submitter whose answers share 9 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 31% of its pending payouts meanwhile. That is 36 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
